_comment: Tau Intelligence — publications manifest. Add an object to `papers` for each publication. The `links` block can include any of: pdf (relative or absolute), arxiv, code, project, bibtex. Order does not matter; the site sorts newest-first by `year`.

papers.title: Safe Flow Q-Learning: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reachability-Based Flow Policies
papers.abstract: SafeFQL combines a Hamilton-Jacobi reachability-inspired safety value function with an efficient one-step flow policy for safe offline RL, achieving 2.5x faster inference than diffusion-style baselines while reducing constraint violations.

papers.title: V-OCBF: Verification-based Optimal Control Barrier Functions
papers.abstract: A verification-based approach to optimal control barrier functions for safe autonomous systems.

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Safe and Optimal Control of Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract: A physics-informed machine learning framework for safe and optimal control of autonomous systems.

papers.title: Epigraph-Guided Flow Matching for Safe and Performant Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: An epigraph-guided flow matching approach for safe and performant offline reinforcement learning.

papers.title: MAD-PINN: A Decentralized Physics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Safe and Optimal Multi-Agent Control
papers.abstract: A decentralized physics-informed machine learning framework for safe and optimal multi-agent control.

papers.title: Semi-supervised Safe Visuomotor Policy Synthesis Using Barrier Certificates
papers.abstract: A semi-supervised approach to safe visuomotor policy synthesis using barrier certificates.

papers.title: RISE: Robust Imitation through Stochastic Encoding
papers.abstract: RISE uses stochastic encoding for robust imitation learning in robotics.
